coverage_notes: Two symbols (AAPL, AMD), ~3 calendar months (~62 trading sessions - comfortably exceeds the 20-session level-expiration bound), includes the 2024-11-29 NYSE early close. This is a starting corpus, not a claim of exhaustive regime coverage; expand via a re-run of _generate_corpus.py with a wider window or more symbols if reducer parity testing needs more diversity than this provides.
final_bar_handling: Each fixture includes one additional real 5-minute bar beyond the declared evaluation boundary (through context_window_end), solely so the frozen batch generate_signals() has the trailing bar it structurally requires. Comparison must stay scoped to confirmations whose entry/confirmation falls within declared_evaluation_window - the extra bar is data plumbing, never itself evaluated.
purpose: Frozen, extracted, immutable fixture corpus for reducer confirmation-output parity testing against the frozen batch generate_signals(). Written before live_slc/reducer.py was implemented, per rev. 6 Step 5.
